_field_notes.boundary_invalid_recall_rate: Fraction of unsafe-rung cross-boundary responses that the HARDENED boundary-invalid scorer (analysis/rescore_final_ci.py:boundary_invalid) classifies as boundary-invalid. This is the canonical headline metric of the paper. Per-cell rates with Wilson 95% CIs are in analysis/rescore_final_ci.csv.
_field_notes.unsafe_cross_boundary_recall_production_: Fraction of unsafe-rung cross-boundary responses that produced any non-null recall (regardless of whether components trace to supplying fragments). This is strictly greater than or equal to boundary_invalid_recall_rate; the gap is fragments unmatched under the HARDENED substring rule.
_field_notes.supported_recall_accuracy: Fraction of supported probe responses producing a recall. Under construction-attached retrieval, every such recall is fragment-supported by design.
_field_notes.absent_refusal_rate: Fraction of absent probe responses that abstain from producing a recall (correct behavior).
_field_notes.partial_refusal_rate: Fraction of partial probe responses that abstain (calibration baseline; see paper §7).
